line.comment: * Called by ZH.Monitor once every 10 hours.
* Expanded 2.2: Player-sector spawning is always enabled on Hard and Insane.
* Easy and Normal use the saved modifier.
* Large Xenon territory reduces the allowed number of pirate bases.
* Add-Ons 2.0.4: Pirate Bases and Yaki Outposts are treated as Pirate Havens.
* Chance to spawn a pirate base. For example, if the chance is 10%, then only 10 numbers (0-9) are valid.
* Mordan4 - don't put pirates in the renegades sector.
* Add-Ons 2.0.4: Rewritten to check for each Pirate Haven (Pirate Base + Yaki Outpost) rather than each Pirate Base.
* Add-Ons 2.0.4: Pirate bases must spawn more than 5 jumps away from every Pirate Haven.
* Should never happen - just in case it dies during the check.
* Cannot be in the same sector as another haven.
* Sector owner strategy affects the chance of spawning here.
* Player sectors have no AI offensive strategy.
* Example: If we have a 10% chance to skip spawning, then numbers 0-9 skip the spawn but numbers 10-99 are OK to proceed with spawning.
* Add-Ons 2.0.4: ZH.Pirate.SpawnBase now returns a station object.
